# Smart Gurukul

> Smart Gurukul (smartgurukul.org) is an AI-powered, gamified school app for Indian schools. Tagline: "Your whole school, connected." (Hindi: "पूरा स्कूल, एक ऐप पर जुड़ा।"). It brings AI (an AI helpdesk assistant inside the app), school work (GPS teacher attendance with no hardware, class attendance, fees, basic payroll, exams and report cards, chat, video calls and events) and games (XP, streaks, weekly leagues, House Wars, Battle Room quizzes and 1v1 Arena challenges) into one app for principals, teachers, students and parents. It is made for private CBSE and State Board schools across India, including school groups, and is built by an IIT-BHU team.

Key facts:
- Brand: Smart Gurukul. Website: https://smartgurukul.org. Contact: sales@smartgurukul.org. Instagram: @smart__gurukul.
- Positioning: AI + School + Games. Most school management software is an office record-keeping tool; Smart Gurukul is designed so teachers, students and parents use it every day.
- Attendance: the class teacher marks daily student attendance in the app (present, absent, late, half-day). Teachers check in by GPS at school from their own phone; the distance to the school's saved location is checked on the server (100 m radius by default). No biometric hardware is needed.
- AI: an AI helpdesk assistant inside the app. Teachers use it for teaching notes and explanations; principals and office staff ask about school records; students get help with topics. It uses a fixed set of checked, school-scoped lookups rather than writing its own database queries.
- Games: one XP score earned from attendance, assessment results, quiz wins and teacher-awarded participation. It drives streaks, weekly leagues (Bronze up to Gurukul Master) and House Wars. Battle Room is a live group quiz; Gurukul Arena is a 1v1 quiz challenge. Quiz battles use questions written by teachers.
- Parents: the same app with a parent login. Parents see their child's attendance, fees and report card, in Hindi or English; all their children are on one login; sign-in is by one-time code.
- Languages: the app works in English and Hindi.
- Getting started: free 1-month pilot. The Smart Gurukul team imports the school's student register and trains staff. Pricing is shared after a demo.
- Coming soon: parent chat and parent alerts, online fee payment, timetable, homework, transport and bus tracking, SMS, ID cards, admissions, AI quiz generation, PDF report cards. Not available yet: hostel, library, statutory payroll (PF/ESI/TDS).
